title: A known extension unexpectedly rewrites the first line on save
symptom: Saving issue-wizard-extension-symptom.txt unexpectedly replaces its first line.

transcript.text: Every time I save issue-wizard-extension-symptom.txt, its first line is replaced. I expect saving to preserve my text. It happens every time in this workspace.

The save-time rewrite is registered by Issue Wizard Known Problem, and the evidence narrows the behavior to that extension. I can disable only vscode-extension-samples.issue-wizard-known-problem for this workspace; other extensions will remain enabled. This changes extension state and may restart the extension host. May I do that?
Yes, disable that extension for this workspace.
Please undo the replaced first line, save issue-wizard-extension-symptom.txt again, and check whether your first line now stays unchanged.
I restored the first line and saved again. It stayed unchanged, so the symptom is gone.

That verification identifies vscode-extension-samples.issue-wizard-known-problem as the owner, not VS Code itself. A microsoft/vscode issue would be the wrong destination. If you want to report the defect, review the extension-maintainer draft below; nothing has been published.

transcript.title: Known Problem sample rewrites the first line when saving the demo document
transcript.body:
Expected: saving issue-wizard-extension-symptom.txt preserves its first line.

Actual: with Issue Wizard Known Problem enabled, every save replaces the first line with the extension's marker. Disabling only vscode-extension-samples.issue-wizard-known-problem and repeating the same save leaves the line unchanged.

Reproduction: open the demo workspace, edit the first line, and save.
